title: Assessment of Circuit Rebreathing During CPAP Therapy
official: Assessment of Circuit Rebreathing During Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) Therapy
summary: The goal of this research is to better understand how different CPAP mask designs affect airflow and rebreathing of exhaled carbon dioxide (CO₂) during sleep in individuals with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Moderate to severe OSA (AHI\>20)
* Self-reported CPAP users or have previously used CPAP
* Self-reported holding pressure of maximum 13 cmH2O (if known)
* Age: 21-70
* BMI: 18-40 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Self-reported severe mouth-breathing
* Requirement for nocturnal supplemental oxygen or other ventilatory support
* Severe cardiovascular or pulmonary disease
* Any unstable or acute medical condition
* Any additional sleep disorder, including insomnia, except for OSA.
